params.name: rangeObj
params.description: Range of the cell(s) whose value to set

params.name: dateValue
params.description: Date value to assign to rangeObj

params.name: formatPattern
params.description: Format pattern for dateValue (default US pattern if omitted); custom pattern text or one of the named constants

sentinelValues.meaning: ISO 8601 full date, "dddd, dd MMMM yyyy".

overloads.semanticRole: The VP SET DATE VALUE command assigns a specified date value to a designated cell range.

constraints: If rangeObj includes multiple cells, the same dateValue is repeated in every cell.
